title: Resonance exercises
description: Practice > Resonance exercises scored on the resonance score: big dog / little dog contrasts and resonance chains. Shown in file order, before the dark-to-bright slide and the whispers.

id.description: Stable id starting with rs-. Practice history refers to it, so never change or reuse one that has shipped.

cue.description: Short name on the exercise card.

sub.description: A few words under the name on the card.

kind.description: dog: dark and bright holds of one vowel in pairs on one note (needs vowel). chain: vowels one after another, each scored on its own (needs vowels and say). Each kind has its own check in src/dsp.js, so a new kind is a code change.

vowel.description: dog: the vowel held, from the formant table in src/dsp.js.

vowels.description: chain: the vowels scored, each on its own. Write the stressed vowels the words in say really have; others are not scored.

held.description: chain: true when the vowels are held on one breath (the demo glides between them) rather than said as words.

say.description: chain: what to say, one line each, shown and read by the demo voice.

why.description: What the exercise is for; the first sentence shows, the rest is behind an info badge.

oneOf.description: A step that depends on the training goal.

steps.description: Steps shown in order. Use an object with feminine and masculine for a step that differs by goal.
